name: Kortia
source:
Imagine yourself being ripped from your home forcefully, waking up with a face you don't recognize, and a world around you that is beyond every dream you've ever had. What if I were to tell you, that is exactly what you will see when you open your eyes? Go on, and face this new world.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
translation:
想象一下，你自己被强行从家里强行带走，醒来时看到的是一张你不认识的面孔，而你周围的世界却超出了你曾经做过的所有梦想。如果我告诉你，这正是你睁开眼睛时所看到的？继续前进，面对这个新世界。

[摘自[url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]官网[/url]]
